1.label: very_easy
1.summary: 2 coupled gate rows; 2 inlets; 1 catcher pocket of 220px; changing 200px/s² crosswind; release gap 4300ms. Latch while the marble is wholly inside the 140px-tall matching chamber; no automatic catch. Inspect concealed inlet connections without starting or pausing the stream; the learned map persists. The same 440px-wide inspection light reveals the falling marble and its recent trail in both modes.
1.natural_language: Move the pointer across the smoked crosswind chamber to inspect the fall through its broad light; the light stays where you leave it. Inspect the lettered inlet mouths to reveal their concealed connections to the numbered gates. Learned routes remain visible and let you anticipate the catcher position. Release the automatic stream. Steer the catcher around each falling marble, then press Enter or Latch Pockets while the whole marble is inside its outlined chamber. Steering takes time. Each marble follows and flips its gates, and changing crosswinds bend its fall. An empty or misaligned latch, or a marble escaping through the floor, ends this episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. full.summary: Drag the moving catcher with pointer capture; release retains its target. The visible pocket-swap button and Space exchange the two pocket assignments at levels 2–5. Press Enter or the shared Latch Pockets button for the same immediate shutter closure; an empty or mismatched closure is irreversible. In both modes, hover or click a lettered inlet mouth to reveal its concealed gate connection; this is a safe information probe before or during the stream. Pointer movement places the same broad inspection light over the smoked chamber, including during a catcher drag; the light retains its column after release.
